paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in Sotah 4a on the measure of seclusion; he holds that it is the time needed for a weaver to tie a thread. Hyman reports that the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, part 1, chapter 2, places him in the generation of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Sotah 4a paragraph fully names Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah and the weaver tying a thread. In the saved Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, question 1, the eleventh returned paragraph discusses Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel’s generation and the twelfth includes Elazar ben Yirmeyah among its sages. This supports Hyman’s report without equating his part-and-chapter locator to the digital paragraph numbering or admitting a chronology independently.
